'''400,324 Henryson''' was a small, crater-ridden [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] that was located in the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]], in the [[Sil'Lume system/Legends|Sil'Lume system]]. The planetoid was about a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] in length and about half a kilometer in both width and thickness. Henryson was the 400,324th planetoid in the Sil'Lume Asteroid Belt to be catalogued as the property of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the site of a hospice.<ref name="JH" />
